description: Block B trajectory output schema — merged Day 7 + Day 8 fields — frozen after Day 8
note: Day 7 introduced cx, cy, velocity_norm fields. Day 8 adds interpolated, track_length, and gap metadata. Both sets required in all Day 8+ tracker outputs. Day 7 SORT files will lack Day 8 fields AND will lack 'reid_model' — Day 9 post-processing backfills 'reid_model':'none' into SORT files and normalises all trackers to this schema. Block C must use .get('reid_model', 'none') defensively.

header_fields.reid_model: string — 'osnet_x1_0_veri_776' for DeepSORT; 'none' (literal string) for SORT and ByteTrack
header_fields.warmup_boundary: int — frames at or below this index are excluded from evaluation
header_fields.cache_frame_index_base: int — always 0 (verified in Day 7 smoke test; must not drift to 1)
header_fields.fragment_filter_applied: bool — always false in Day 8 outputs; set true by Day 9 post-processing
header_fields.interpolation_applied: bool — always false in Day 8 outputs; set true by Day 9 post-processing
header_fields.tracks: dict keyed by track_id string, each value is a list of track_entry objects

track_entry_fields.cx: float — bbox centre-x in 640x640 space (inherited from Day 7 schema)
track_entry_fields.cy: float — bbox centre-y in 640x640 space (inherited from Day 7 schema)
track_entry_fields.velocity_norm: float | null — pixel displacement per second normalised by frame diagonal; null for first frame of track (inherited from Day 7 schema)
track_entry_fields.interpolated: bool — always false in Day 8 raw outputs; set true only after Day 9 interpolation pass
track_entry_fields.track_length: int — total length of this track (computed Day 8, used by Day 9 fragment filter)

gap_metadata_per_track.note: Stored in the trajectory header under a 'gap_analysis' key, keyed by track_id
gap_metadata_per_track.max_gap: int — largest consecutive gap in frames for this track

backward_compatibility.reid_model_missing: Day 7 SORT files lack 'reid_model'. Use .get('reid_model', 'none') everywhere. Day 9 backfills 'none' into SORT headers.
backward_compatibility.day8_fields_missing: Day 7 SORT entries lack 'interpolated' and 'track_length'. Use .get('interpolated', False) and .get('track_length', None).
